guidance.statement: Core business can do at least high single-digit to early double-digit growth
Board-approved investment of Rs. 1,400 crore in Exide Energy in FY27, a mix of capex and opex working capital
Exports uncertainty expected to remain for at least the first half of FY27
Lithium cell factory utilisation guided at 25-30% in the first year

Phase 1 capacity of 6 GWh with provision to go to 12 GWh in the next few years

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Auto Components & Equipments

operating_notes.text: Sulfur price rose from ₹15/kg a year back to ₹74/kg at the April exit, with Q4 up 40% YoY and about 20% sequentially.
The 6 GWh Phase-I cell capacity is split 3 GWh cylindrical (two-wheelers) and 3 GWh prismatic (four-wheelers, buses, telecom, BESS).
UPS revenue was about ₹2,300 Cr in FY26; auto and non-auto is roughly 53:47 of the mix.
Solar achieved its highest ever quarterly revenue of ₹400 Cr plus, with volume growth of about 12-14%.
Home inverter business ranges between 15% and 25% of revenue depending on season.
About 70-75% of the 3-wheeler lithium demand is aftermarket retrofitment, where Exide already has a dealer network.
